result.brief: 提出 SERF 自正则化框架，用 EMA 教师对连续扩散语言模型的去噪轨迹做噪声到干净的自蒸馏，含表征对齐与输出分布对齐两种变体，提升训练效率与少步生成质量。
result.reason: Self-distillation on denoising trajectory for continuous diffusion language models, aligning intermediate representations and token distributions; directly targets continuous language modeling.
